summary: Full-stack verification of Longitudinal Growth Tracking (P1-C). Backend /api/analytics/growth passes all 7 pytest cases (auth 401, empty state, full-shape with 4 seeded summaries, delta math, days_tracked, repeated-call stability, legacy-summary handling). Frontend GrowthTracker on /my-plan renders current score 50/100 with Needs Support label, Recharts line chart with 4 data points and both reference lines (Prepared/75/green, Moderately ready/55/tan), 3 WindowCards (Last 30/60/90 days) with correct signed deltas (-25, -25, -8) shown as red TrendingDown chips. Empty state (fresh guest) renders growth-empty with 'Your growth story starts here' copy.

issues: 'Moderately ready' reference-line label overlaps slightly with the last data point label at Jul 17 (both anchored insideTopRight at y=55 and y=75). Cosmetic — readable but tight on 1440px width.

Spec calls for a 'link to Reports' but the implementation is plain prose ('Generate your first Mediation Summary from the Reports tab…') — no clickable <Link to='/summary'>. Consider making 'Reports tab' a hyperlink to satisfy the acceptance criteria and improve wayfinding.

action_items: Optional: turn 'Reports tab' in the growth-empty copy into a <Link to='/summary'> for spec compliance.
Optional: nudge the Recharts ReferenceLine labels (position='insideTopLeft' or add dx offset) so 'Moderately ready' doesn't visually touch the trailing data point.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_routes.py — good separation of _summary_to_point / _pick_baseline / _build_window / _build_insights. Delta math is safe (guards None) and pymongo cursor is bounded to 500 with a projection excluding _id.

_pick_baseline fallback to points[0] is intentional per spec but WindowCard shows the SAME baseline (May 15) for both 30d and 60d for parent1's data because there is no point older than today-60d. This is the documented behavior but the user-facing 30d vs 60d cards end up nearly identical, which may confuse parents. Consider surfacing a small 'baseline: earliest snapshot' hint on the card when fallback triggered.

GrowthTracker.jsx line 366: uses `points.length >= 2` to decide chart vs first-snapshot info panel — matches backend `has_history` flag but relies on client re-derivation. Prefer trusting `has_history` directly.
DimensionRow renders `from ?? '—'` but 0 is a valid dimension score (0 would render as 0, correct). No bug — noted for future work.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved, chart + windows + empty state verified)

test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (4 summaries, current overall=50) — verified. Guest via POST /api/auth/guest — verified empty state.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing seeded summaries for parent1@test.com.

Backend response for parent1 returned {has_history:true, points:4, current.overall:50, days_tracked:66, windows.30d.delta:-25, windows.60d.delta:-25, windows.90d.delta:-8, insights:[]}. First point (May 13) is a legacy summary — its dimension keys (communication/trust/child_alignment/conflict) come back as null which is correctly rendered as '—' in the WindowCard from column. Frontend renders under /my-plan#growth using recharts 3.6.0.
